card.name: Linking words in fertility treatment text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, by, when, following, with, to) in fertility and gynecologic labels, right before a monitoring or procedure term such as hCG administration, ultrasound, serum estradiol or cervical dilation.

modes.label: Linking word before hCG or monitoring
modes.description: A preposition after day, assessed, indicated or response, ahead of hCG, ultrasound or estradiol.
modes.example: Treatment with ganirelix acetate should be continued daily until the day<< of>> hCG administration.

modes.label: Cervical procedure wording
modes.description: The word cervical or when before dilation or anesthesia in IUS insertion and removal text.
modes.example: Analgesia, paracervical anesthesia,<< cervical>> dilation, alligator forceps or other

modes.label: Step number spacing
modes.description: The space before a step number in injection instructions.
modes.example: Step 1: Wash your hands thoroughly with soap and water. Step<< >>2: Carefully clean the injection site
